title: Gripper 8: Grip test line (MuJoCo)
description: Every gripper of Gripper 7 and Hagelslag in a row, each over the same grocery item (Gripper 7's groceries, the Hagelslag shelf's packages, or a deformable bag of chips or of potatoes), and an automatic test for all at once: grip, lift, a full turn about x, a metre forward, put down and let go. Which ones hold on?
